findings.summary: The implementer's report claims 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the commit range touches only this one file (12 insertions/3 deletions) — the test file apps/web/app/queues/__tests__/historical-sync-consumer.server.test.ts has no diff and is unchanged in git history/working tree. The only existing chaining test ('preserves source field when chaining to next page') exercises the unchanged Strava full-page path; there is no test for the new Intervals.icu continuation signal (partial page now continues, previously would have stopped) or for the MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES=24 hard cap actually terminating the loop. A future off-by-one or inverted condition in this exact logic (e.g. `page <=` vs `page <`) would ship undetected.

findings.summary: The unchanged comment '// Partial or empty page = we're done' on the else branch no longer fully describes why Intervals.icu stops — it can now also stop after a full/non-empty page purely because payload.page hit MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES, which isn't a partial or empty page.
